methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Kunin operates in Robotics & Manufacturing at an undisclosed stage. The relevant peer universe comprises one public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private competitors, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. The sector contains ten same-sector peers total, though stage and valuation-tier specificity remains limited.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. The analysis identified zero same-stage comparables, zero adjacent-stage peers, and zero similar-tier private companies meeting minimum threshold requirements (≥3 datapoints). While ten robotics and manufacturing companies exist in the broader peer set, none satisfied the narrow filtering criteria necessary for reliable median benchmarking. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given the heterogeneity of stage, technology maturity, and capital efficiency across the robotics landscape.

The limited comparable set and undisclosed stage/prior valuation prevent triangulation across multiple methodologies. Any valuation conclusion would require supplementary approaches—DCF modeling with explicit margin and deployment assumptions, or precedent transaction analysis in robotics automation—to establish a defensible range. The key uncertainty is stage classification: early-stage hardware ventures trade at fundamentally different multiples than Series C+ companies with production revenue. Without additional operational metrics (revenue, deployment count, burn rate), a quantitatively grounded valuation estimate cannot be responsibly supported by the available data.
